description: The SimpleFeed News & Video Content Marketplace brings rights-cleared content into OpenAI. Search hundreds of premium publishers by topic, outlet, publisher, metadata date and more. Get article summaries, full text, images and video in HTML, markdown and vectors for inference and grounding. The App brings SimpleFeed Paid MCP servers for semantic article search and publisher discovery.  Purchase query based access via a click-to-accept license with your AWS account. Sign in with OAuth after subscribing to save tokens, be rights compliant, and improve your App.
